title: strategic-engagement-ops-slate-and-renewal-sprint
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, modular QBR / renewal conversation slate and sprint playbook tailored for strategic accounts (standard + enterprise tracks). It emphasizes outcome alignment, technical health signals, and a combined risk/expansion decision matrix to drive renewal commitments and net-new ARR motions.

How to use this pack:
- Pick the meeting length (20/45/90) and the corresponding slide track below.
- Populate the Technical Health Snapshot and Adoption Velocity Score from telemetry and CSM notes 72 hours prior.
- Use the Risk & Upsell Matrix to set an internal red/yellow/green status and recommended next step.
- Export the one-page Renewal Sprint (90/60/30 day) into the customer tracker and assign owners.

Meeting tracks (choose one):
- 20-minute "Executive Touch" (standard): Outcome recaps (2 slides), Top asks (1 slide), Renewal ask (1 slide) — minimal technical detail; high-level ROI focus.
- 45-minute "Stakeholder Review" (standard+enterprise mix): Executive recap (1), Product usage + adoption velocity (2), Tech health + risks (2), Success stories & outcomes (2), Renewal options & timeline (2), Next steps & owners (1).
- 90-minute "Strategic Partnership Workshop" (enterprise): Full stakeholder mapping and roadmap sync. Includes breakout prompts for co-created outcomes and a mini-commitment workshop to lock renewal terms.

Slide skeletons (speaker cues included):
1) Cover + Meeting Objectives (speaker cue: "State 3 measurable objectives for this quarter")
2) Executive TL;DR: Top 3 wins + top 3 risks (cue: "One-sentence win, one-sentence risk per owner")
3) Outcome Commitments (customer-stated goals vs. current status) (cue: "Read aloud commitments and confirm")
4) Adoption Velocity Score (one-slide summary) (cue: "Highlight top 3 features that drive value")
5) Technical Health Snapshot (latency, error-rate, integration posture, security issues) (cue: "Call out items with active tickets")
6) Usage Trends & Cost Efficiency (tokens/embeddings/ops trends, cost per 1k tokens, top 5 routes by spend) (cue: "Point out anomalies; propose a quick optimization")
7) Success Story: 1–2 short customer narratives (cue: "Tie to metrics: time saved, error reduced, revenue enabled")
8) Risk & Upsell Matrix (4-quadrant: renewal-risk vs expansion-opportunity) (cue: "Recommend red/yellow/green and proposed action")
9) Renewal Options & Terms (standard renewal, committed dedicated, pilot of private deployment) (cue: "Surface recommended path and commercial ask")
10) Renewal Sprint & Owner RACI (90/60/30 day with owners and deliverables) (cue: "Confirm owner commitments live")
11) Open Issues & Parking Lot (cue: "Agree remaining open items and owners")
12) Ask & Next Steps (cue: "Clear ask and due dates")

Unique templates included in this pack (novel to our library):
- Adoption Velocity Scorecard (AVS): a 6-metric composite (DAU/WAU ratio, % feature depth, prompt re-use rate, cost-per-triggered-response, KV-cache hit rate, number of eval regressions). Each metric is normalized 0–100 and averaged. Threshold guidance for standard vs enterprise tiers included.
- Technical Health Snapshot (THS): one-slide checklist with categories: Inference stability (p99 latency drift), Accuracy drift (eval-based), Integration health (sync failures), Security posture (KMS/HSM validation), Observability gaps (tracing on/off). Each item gets a status + action.
- Stakeholder Influence/Interest Map: quick visual to show primary economic buyer, technical champion, procurement, legal. Includes suggested prep lines tailored to each archetype.
- Risk & Upsell Matrix: quadrants labeled "High Renewal Risk / High Upsell" etc., with templated plays per quadrant (e.g., technical remediation + proof-of-value pilot for high risk/high upsell).
- One-page Renewal Sprint CSV sample (pasteable) for trackers: columns: account, renewal-date, current-status, recommended-path, primary-owner, secondary-owner, 90d-goals, 60d-goals, 30d-goals, blockers, next-check-in, notes.

One-page Renewal Sprint (example CSV row):
"Acme Corp,2026-05-15,Yellow,committed-dedicated,Maya Patel,Diego Alvarez,Decrease-latency-20%,Enable-auto-scaling,Finish-contract-addendum,Ticket-#4521,2026-03-28,Need-Legal-signoff"

Risk scoring rubric (short):
- Green: AVS > 70, THS all green, usage growth > 5% month-over-month. Action: Offer standard renewal + 1-year price guard.
- Yellow: AVS 45–70, THS has 1–2 amber items, usage flat. Action: 60-day technical remediation plan + executive alignment.
- Red: AVS < 45, THS red items (latency/error/regression), usage decline. Action: Trigger escalation, proposed pilot with dedicated capacity or rollback to stable model; consider pause in auto-renew.

Speaker note examples (copy-paste into slide notes):
- Exec TL;DR: "In the last quarter we helped ship X features that reduced customer support tickets by Y% and improved model latency by Zms. To keep that momentum, we recommend a committed capacity path that secures priority kernels and dedicated throughput."
- Tech health: "We currently have a sustained p95 under target due to key route contention — mitigation plan is a per-route reallocation and a 2-week canary. Owner: Infra Eng (Evan Chen)."

Customer objection scripts (short):
- Price pushback: "We can test a 3-month committed pilot at a reduced rate while we implement the cost-optimizations. If we hit the AVS improvement target, we convert to a longer term commitment."
- Concern about migration or private deploy: "We have a predefined lift-and-shift checklist for Private deployments; typical ETA for mid-sized accounts is 6–8 weeks with a dedicated Solutions Eng lead."

Meeting prep checklist for CSMs (72h before):
- Pull AVS metrics and THS snapshot; paste into slides.
- Confirm stakeholders and their roles; add to stakeholder map.
- Preload key logs and open tickets; link to slide 5.
- Draft renewal ask language and export renewal sprint CSV row.
- Run a 20-minute pre-call with internal stakeholders (Solutions Eng, Sales AE, Legal if needed).

Follow-up cadence (recommended):
- 48 hours: share slide deck + renewal sprint CSV.
- 7 days: align on 60-day remediation tasks and sign-off.
- 30 days: executive check-in on sprint progress.

Owner/RACI quick template (one-liner entries to paste):
- Renewal lead: primary-owner (CSM)
- Technical remediation lead: solutions-eng
- Commercial owner: AE or account-exec
- Legal: legal-bizops

Annotated slide pack file names (for version control):
- 01-cover-objectives.md (skeleton)
- 02-exec-tldr.md
- 03-outcome-commitments.md
- 04-adoption-velocity.md
- 05-tech-health.md
- 06-usage-costs.md
- 07-success-story.md
- 08-risk-upsell-matrix.md
- 09-renewal-options.md
- 10-renewal-sprint.md

Open TODOs (internal):
- Add automated AVS extraction to dashboards (JIRA:CS-8792) — Priya
- Create a one-click export of renewal CSV from console — Diego
- Review legal boilerplate for committed capacity addendum (Legal review deadline: 2026-03-10) — Evan

Why this is different from existing templates:
- Metric-first: AVS + THS prioritizes signal from telemetry rather than only commercial conversation.
- Decision-focused: Risk & Upsell Matrix maps to concrete plays (technical pilot, commercial concession, legal escalator).
- Modular meeting tracks: 20/45/90 minute scaffolding enables consistent delivery across CSMs and varying stakeholder availability.

Immediate next steps if you adopt this pack:
1) Copy the slide skeletons into your account deck templates.
2) Run one shadow play for a mid-tier strategic customer next week.
3) Report back top 3 friction points in the internal retro — we will iterate the AVS thresholds after 3 pilots.
